scope: Helper workflow only; no LLM or agent end-to-end measurement.

methodology.processes: One fresh process per variant, scenario and run; fixture setup and interpreter startup excluded.
methodology.helper_commands: In-process helper main() invocations; per-command Python startup is not measured.
methodology.stages: Capture, evidence/draft preparation, one nested publish validation, and publish excluding that validation.
methodology.output_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of captured helper stdout; report file bytes are artifact_bytes.
